products.name: Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil
products.tagline: Golden and nutty — the everyday oil of Andhra kitchens.
products.description: Cold-pressed slowly from groundnuts in a traditional wooden ghani (gaanuga), then left to settle naturally before bottling. Rich nutty aroma for tempering, curries, chutneys and everyday home cooking.

products.name: Cold-Pressed White Sesame Oil
products.tagline: Traditional gingelly (nuvvula nune) with a gentle aroma.
products.description: Cold-pressed in a wooden ghani from white sesame seeds — a staple for pickles, podis, pulusu and traditional South Indian recipes.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Coconut Oil
products.tagline: Clear, fragrant oil from mature coconuts.
products.description: Cold-pressed in a wooden ghani from mature coconuts. Naturally fragrant; it may solidify in cool weather — keep the bottle somewhere warm to liquefy.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (Kachi Ghani)
products.tagline: Bold and pungent — made for pickles and curries.
products.description: Cold, slow-pressed (kachi ghani) from mustard seeds, with the bold pungency that defines North and East Indian dishes and Andhra avakaya.

products.name: Pure Ghee
products.tagline: Golden, aromatic ghee prepared the traditional way.
products.description: Butter heated slowly until clear and golden, then filtered — for rice and dal, sweets, rotis and pooja.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Black Sesame Oil
products.tagline: Deep, earthy oil from black sesame seeds.
products.description: Cold-pressed in a wooden ghani from black sesame seeds; darker and more robust than white sesame oil. Used in traditional recipes and also traditionally for oil massage.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Sunflower Oil
products.tagline: Light and mild for everyday cooking.
products.description: Cold-pressed in a wooden ghani from sunflower seeds — light in colour and mild in flavour for everyday cooking.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Castor Oil
products.description: Cold-pressed from castor seeds. Traditionally used in hair and skin care routines and for lamps. Please follow the label for usage.

products.name: Pure Honey
products.description: Golden natural honey with a rich, floral sweetness — for breakfast, warm drinks and desserts. May crystallise naturally; stand the jar in warm water to make it runny.
